title: First hearing the blues: Mamie, Bessie, Trixie and Clara Smith
summary: He listened to the words of the blues singers named Smith, none of whom were related.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Where did you first hear the Blues, that you knew it was the Blues?

I don't know really. But I listened to the words of the Blues then. It was Mamie Smith I used to listen to, and Bessie Smith...and Trixie Smith, yeah... And there were some other Smiths then, too. There was a lot of Smiths...
Clara, yeah. Just a gang of them.
They weren't related. But you know, everybody was named Smith them days. Smith, Johnson or Jones. [LAUGHS]
